source: api-gateway-store-api resource contracts, executed through the hosted connector
credentials: Merchant admin tokens and the merchant’s own MCP connection only; apps may not hold domain/email-settings scopes.

step_up.flow: Call request_verification_code with the exact action, target_type and target_id documented by the selected tool; Tringify emails the code to the connected merchant. Ask the merchant for it and pass it as otp_code. The connected tool cannot invent or bypass this code.

guide: The Tringify noreply sender is permanent, even when you choose a custom transactional default. It counts toward the transactional limit. Separate transactional and marketing limits are returned by the service; check the displayed limits rather than assuming a fixed number. Creating a sender does not choose it as the default. If a custom transactional identity becomes unavailable, Tringify uses the provided sender and notifies you; marketing is never reassigned automatically.

Custom sending domains require ownership of their registrable base through an active verified domain in Settings > Domains. For example, verified www.example.com can authorize registering mail.example.com. Each sending identity still needs its own SES verification. Website verification alone does not authorize email delivery.

For Hostinger, use the Name relative to the actual DNS zone and keep the full Target value. In zone example.com, token._domainkey.mail.example.com becomes token._domainkey.mail in Name. In a separately delegated mail.example.com zone, it becomes token._domainkey. Copy each Name and Target separately. If the zone could not be determined, confirm it with your DNS provider before removing a suffix. Keep all current verification records after success.

A configured Tringify DNS zone is not proof of authoritative delegation. Review the configured zone, exact records, conflicts, delegation status and SES readiness separately. Records queued or present do not mean email is verified. Keep external DNS instructions available until delegation is active. Resolve conflicting merchant records deliberately; Tringify does not overwrite them. After restarting an identity, publish its new DKIM records.

DMARC is reported as valid, missing, invalid or unknown. Tringify checks the sending domain before the organizational domain. A failed lookup is unknown, not permission to add another policy. Preserve an existing valid policy. Optional custom MAIL FROM uses a dedicated unused subdomain with its own MX and SPF records; never replace your inbound root MX or root SPF. Failed MAIL FROM verification rejects sending instead of silently switching envelopes. DKIM alignment can satisfy DMARC independently; strict SPF alignment requires an exact domain match.

Reply-To has separate active and pending values. Pending links expire after seven days; resend is available after the server cooldown. Save the active value to cancel the pending request and revoke its link; save the pending value to resend. Refresh after inbox confirmation. Clearing the active value removes the Reply-To override, not an externally hosted From mailbox. Reply-To applies to merchant transactional and marketing messages; platform notifications use their separate identity.

Email history uses a stable cursor and remains navigable beyond 10,000 messages. Calendar date filters use the store timezone, including daylight-saving changes. History and totals share type, status and date filters. Totals show their calculation time and may be cached for one minute; a failed request must be shown as unavailable. Sent includes sent, bounced and complained outcomes. Delivered means recipient-server acceptance, not an inbox placement or read receipt. Delivery rate is delivered divided by sent.

History distinguishes refusal before submission, provider acceptance, retry delay, uncertain acceptance and delivery feedback. Do not automatically resend an uncertain message. Check the recipient suppression from its history row or browse suppressions; recipient addresses are available only while the associated history is retained for 90 days. Lift an eligible permanent-bounce block only after resolving the mailbox problem. A spam-complaint block cannot be lifted. Suppression is different from marketing consent.

Identity, sender, default and reply-to changes require fresh action-bound verification. Installed and third-party apps cannot hold domain or email-settings scopes. The merchant’s own Store API admin token or MCP connection still needs the granted permissions and the same verification. Public contact email is a separate storefront field; it is not your owner login, sender or Reply-To address.

India and EU use their configured SES account and region; use only the records returned for this identity. Production readiness, regional activation, account identity inventory and daily/rate headroom must all be available. Shared capacity can delay sending without changing your allowance or sender choice. Marketing includes a visible unsubscribe footer and one-click headers; opening the unsubscribe link alone does not unsubscribe. Transactional and test messages do not use marketing unsubscribe headers.
